scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm --filter @sapling/api dev" "pnpm --filter @sapling/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @sapling/api build && pnpm --filter @sapling/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @sapling/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @sapling/web typecheck
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d mongo redis
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:marketing && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run security:static && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:secrets
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @sapling/contracts build && pnpm --filter @aiquest/learning-core build && pnpm --filter @aiquest/client-sdk build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @sapling/api test:unit && pnpm --filter @sapling/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @sapling/api test:coverage && pnpm --filter @sapling/web test:coverage
scripts.quality:push: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:secrets && pnpm run security:static && pnpm run security:secrets
